questions.prompt: What percentage of an 18-carat gold ring is gold?
A 10 g chain contains 8 g of gold. What is its carat value?
Why is solder used to join electrical wires?
options: It has a low melting point
questions.explain: Solder melts at a low temperature (about 183 °C), so it can join wires without damaging parts.

questions.prompt: Using particles, why is an alloy usually harder than the pure metal?
options: Different-sized atoms disrupt the layers so they can't slide easily
questions.explain: Mixed atom sizes stop layers sliding, making the alloy harder.

questions.prompt: What does the hallmark '916' on Indian gold jewellery mean?
Explain why 22-carat gold is preferred for jewellery over 24-carat gold.
questions.modelAnswer: 24-carat gold is pure gold, which is very soft, so jewellery would bend and scratch easily. 22-carat gold is an alloy with a little copper or silver, which makes it harder and stronger while still not tarnishing.
rubric: It still looks like gold / doesn't tarnish
questions.explain: Alloying improves hardness while keeping gold's best properties.
